matched_seeds: all policies run each scenario with its own scenario seed

config.ant_allocation: ants_per_person per routable person (ID order); cap max_ants_per_iteration; rotating window when capped
config.candidate_routes: best route per (person, first move); re-scored with final load; rank (cost, length, move order)
config.congestion_model: time_indexed_load_of_other_best_routes; iteration0_static_bfs_descent_routes; exit_queue_fifo_throughput_1 (own entry approximated by -1)
config.coordination: priority (best route length, person id), routed people first; one_step_target_reservation; no swap; resolver repair rounds; unrepaired blocked -> stay
config.deposit_rule: after evaporation: iteration_best feasible ant per person deposit_q*d0/C; best_so_far per person elite_weight*deposit_q*d0/C; tau <= tau_max
config.evaporation_rule: after ants: tau <- max(tau_min, (1-rho)*tau) on every edge
config.feasibility: reaches safe exit over cells not burning now; deterministic certain hazard pruned; stochastic forecasts never make a route infeasible
config.final_ant: after iterations: one greedy ant (q0=1, no draws) per routable person without a route
config.fire_risk: public_rule_layer_bfs; deterministic_exact_pruned_at_1; stochastic_soft: layer1 1-(1-p)^(b*n), layer>=2 P(Binomial(n,p)>=l) lower bound; exit uses k-1
config.heuristic: eta = 1/(step_cost(v,k) + h(v) - h(u) + 1); h = static exit distance
config.no_route_mode: shelter: stay or open unclaimed neighbour, min step1 hazard then max fire layer
config.route_cost: sum_k[1 + w_fire*hazard + w_exposure*burning_neighbours_now + w_congestion*load + w_bottleneck*load*bottleneck + w_occupied*occupied_now(k=1)] + w_queue*exit_wait + w_unsafe*[max_hazard >= unsafe_threshold]
config.transition_rule: acs_pseudo_random_proportional: argmax(tau^alpha*eta^beta) w.p. q0 else roulette; ties N,S,E,W

wall_limit_rule: min(6 h, max(900 s, 1.5 x pilot upper comparison estimate)), checked between episodes
